rationale: AREVEI is a platform for founders building businesses. It demands authority, clarity, and precision. A minimal, typography-driven, high-contrast design instills trust and feels like a premium workspace, distinguishing it from playful/casual SaaS tools.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter). Avoid generic sans for headings.

body.usage: Clear, modern, and highly legible for dashboards and CMS editor views.

mono.usage: Use strictly for AI Chat, prompt displays, code snippets, tokens, and technical labels to give an 'AI Native' engineering feel.

typography.install_instructions: Load Cabinet Grotesk and Satoshi from Fontshare (https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=cabinet-grotesk@800,900,700&f[]=satoshi@400,500&display=swap). Load JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts.

marketing.style: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetric, heavily relies on negative space.

dashboard.style: Mode B: Control Room Grid. Dense, cardless (sharp edges), strict hierarchy.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white hover:bg-[#333333] transition-colors rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.secondary: border border-[#0A0A0A] text-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-[#F4F4F5] transition-colors rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.ai_action: bg-[#0055FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0044CC] rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-wider

cards.marketing: border border-[#E5E5E5] bg-[#F4F4F5] p-8 md:p-12 rounded-none

ai_chat.container: border-l border-[#E5E5E5] bg-[#F9FAFB] h-full flex flex-col
ai_chat.message_user: font-body text-[#0A0A0A] bg-white border border-[#E5E5E5] p-4 rounded-none self-end max-w-[85%]
ai_chat.message_ai: font-mono text-sm text-[#525252] p-4 self-start max-w-[90%]
ai_chat.streaming_indicator: inline-block w-2 h-4 bg-[#FF3B30] animate-pulse ml-1

inputs.text: border-b-2 border-[#E5E5E5] bg-transparent focus:border-[#0A0A0A] focus:ring-0 rounded-none px-0 py-2 transition-colors font-body text-base w-full
inputs.command_palette: font-mono text-lg bg-white border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] p-4

navigation.marketing: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5E5E5] px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center
navigation.dashboard: border-b border-[#E5E5E5] bg-white px-6 py-4 flex justify-between items-center

motion.hover_states: Crisp and instant. No sluggish fades.
motion.page_load: Framer motion staggered fade-in for lists/grids.

image_urls.description: Abstract modern architecture with sleek futuristic elements, used for the main marketing hero section overlay.
Grayscale architectural abstract image to use alongside feature lists.
Founders/team working, used in the 'About' or 'Who is this for' section.
Subtle light paper texture for background layered depth.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. The selected monochrome palette naturally enforces high contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Cabinet Grotesk, Satoshi, and JetBrains Mono properly in the main css or HTML head.
Implement the marketing pages using raw HTML/Tailwind to allow asymmetrical, large-spacing layouts (Grid Mode A).

Implement the Dashboard and CMS elements using Shadcn UI but aggressively override default styling to match the sharp, cardless, typography-driven style (remove heavy borders/shadows, enforce sharp 0px radius).
Ensure the AI Chat component uses streaming token simulation UI with a visible cursor/indicator.
Use data-testid extensively for all critical UI boundaries.
